Control Description: New user access requires documented approval before provisioning
Test Objective: Determine whether new user access was properly authorized
Audit Procedure: Select new user accounts and compare approval timestamps with account creation timestamps
Evidence Reviewed: Access request tickets; manager approvals; application owner approvals; account creation logs
Auditor Conclusion: The sampled access requests had documented approvals before access provisioning. Control operated effectively for the samples tested.

Control Description: Privileged accounts are restricted to approved personnel and reviewed periodically
Test Objective: Determine whether privileged access is appropriately restricted and reviewed
Audit Procedure: Inspect the privileged account listing and verify documented quarterly reviews and resolution of exceptions
Evidence Reviewed: Privileged account listing; quarterly review sign-offs; remediation tickets
Exception Identified: Two privileged accounts lacked evidence of documented quarterly review.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the samples tested because two accounts lacked review evidence. Further investigation is required.

Control Description: HR termination notifications trigger timely account disablement
Test Objective: Determine whether terminated employees' access was disabled promptly
Audit Procedure: Compare sampled HR termination records with account disablement timestamps
Evidence Reviewed: HR termination records; access disablement tickets; system access logs
Auditor Conclusion: All sampled terminated employee accounts were disabled within the simulated company policy timeframe.

Control Description: Application owners perform periodic user access reviews
Test Objective: Determine whether user access reviews were completed and exceptions resolved
Audit Procedure: Inspect quarterly user access reviews and trace identified inappropriate permissions to remediation evidence
Evidence Reviewed: User access listings; application owner sign-offs; remediation records
Exception Identified: One quarterly review lacked documented application owner sign-off.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the sample tested because one quarterly review lacked evidence of approval.
